titulo: Middle East live: Trump says Board of Peace reaches Hamas disarmament deal
cuerpo: US President Donald Trump has said that his Board of Peace has reached an agreement to disarm Hamas and all other armed groups in Gaza. Meanwhile, mediator Pakistan insists that negotiations between Iran and the United States are ongoing, even as Washington carried out a "heavy wave of strikes" on its foe in retaliation for fresh attacks targeting Jordan. Follow our liveblog for all the latest updates.
